Off Calendar Feb-14-2006 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
Appearance:
Eric D. MacFarland, appeared for Plaintiff/moving party
No other appearance.

Ruling:
Hearing held. Tentative Ruling adopted: Plaintiff's motion to deem certain matters admitted is ordered off calendar for failure to comply with CCP Section 1005. CCP Section 1005 requires that motions be served and filed at least 16 court days prior to the hearing, with five calendar days added if the motion was served by mail. The motion was filed on January 20, 2006 and served by United State mail and is therefore untimely. COMM: BRUCE E. CHAN
